fusions.name: Anvil Fist
fusions.desc: The strike deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it [Frostbite] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead-Weight Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Leaden] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Stand Like a Post
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Tempered by Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
